test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Identify the most suitable title for the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Border Disputes and Political Fuel**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the ongoing boundary dispute between Maharashtra and Karnataka, highlighting the disruptions caused.
 
• It mentions the linguistic basis for state reorganization and the dissatisfaction over Belgavi's allocation.
 
• The passage also emphasizes the role of politicians in exacerbating the issue through their actions and rhetoric.
 
• Additionally, it touches on the need for an active interstate council to manage such disputes and maintain India’s unified market.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2: Border Disputes and Political Fuel**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1:** The passage does not primarily focus on political corruption.
 
• **Option 3:** Although the passage mentions multilingualism, it is not the central theme.
 
• **Option 4:** The passage does not discuss religious issues but rather linguistic and political dimensions.
